   122	def parent_name(name):
   123	    if name == '.':
   124	        return None
   125	    rest = name[name.index('.') + 1:]
   126	    return rest if rest else '.'

   129	def at_or_below(name, origin):
   130	    """True when `name` is `origin` or a whole-label descendant of it."""
   131	    if origin == '.':
   132	        return True
   133	    if name == origin:
   134	        return True
   135	    return name.endswith('.' + origin)

   138	def wildcard_name(name):
   139	    if name == '.':
   140	        return '*.'
   141	    return '*.' + name

   151	def check_aaaa_data(text):
   152	    need('%' not in text)
   153	    try:
   154	        return ipaddress.IPv6Address(text).compressed
   155	    except (ValueError, TypeError):

   159	def check_txt_data(text):
   160	    need(len(text) <= MAX_TXT_CHARS)
   161	    for char in text:
   162	        need('\u0020' <= char <= '\u007e')

   166	def check_data(rtype, value):
   167	    text = as_str(value)
   168	    if rtype == 'A':
   169	        return check_a_data(text)
   170	    if rtype == 'AAAA':
   171	        return check_aaaa_data(text)
   172	    if rtype == 'TXT':
   173	        return check_txt_data(text)
   174	    return check_name(text)

   183	def check_record(value):
   184	    """Validate a record object; return the canonical (owner, type, data)."""
   185	    obj = exact_keys(as_dict(value), ('owner', 'type', 'data'))
   186	    owner = check_name(obj['owner'])
   187	    rtype = check_type(obj['type'])
   188	    data = check_data(rtype, obj['data'])
   189	    return (owner, rtype, data)

   204	def reject_pairs(pairs):
   205	    seen = set()
   206	    out = {}
   207	    for key, value in pairs:
   208	        need(key not in seen)
   209	        seen.add(key)
   210	        out[key] = value
   211	    return out

   214	def container_depth(value):
   215	    """Iterative maximum nesting depth of containers (root container == 1)."""
   216	    best = 0
   217	    stack = [(value, 1)]
   218	    while stack:
   219	        node, depth = stack.pop()
   220	        if depth > best:
   221	            best = depth
   222	            if best > MAX_DEPTH:
   223	                return best
   224	        child = depth + 1
   225	        if isinstance(node, dict):
   226	            for item in node.values():
   227	                stack.append((item, child))
   228	        elif isinstance(node, list):
   229	            for item in node:
   230	                stack.append((item, child))
   231	    return best

   234	def build_zone(obj):
   235	    exact_keys(obj, ('origin', 'records'))
   236	    origin = check_name(obj['origin'])
   237	    raw_records = as_list(obj['records'])
   238	    rrsets = {}
   239	    owner_types = {}
   240	    for raw in raw_records:
   241	        owner, rtype, data = check_record(raw)
   242	        need(at_or_below(owner, origin))
   243	        rrsets.setdefault((owner, rtype), set()).add(data)
   244	        owner_types.setdefault(owner, set()).add(rtype)
   245	    for (owner, rtype), values in rrsets.items():
   246	        need(len(values) <= MAX_RRSET_DISTINCT)
   247	    for owner, types in owner_types.items():
   248	        if 'CNAME' in types:
   249	            need(len(types) == 1)
   250	            need(len(rrsets[(owner, 'CNAME')]) == 1)
   251	            need(owner != origin)
   252	    existing = {origin}
   253	    for owner in owner_types:
   254	        node = owner
   255	        while True:
   256	            if node in existing:
   257	                break
   258	            existing.add(node)
   259	            if node == origin:
   260	                break
   261	            node = parent_name(node)
   262	    by_owner = {}
   263	    for (owner, rtype), values in rrsets.items():
   264	        by_owner.setdefault(owner, {})[rtype] = tuple(sorted(values))
   265	    return {
   266	        'origin': origin,
   267	        'labels': label_count(origin),
   268	        'suffix': None if origin == '.' else '.' + origin,
   269	        'existing': existing,
   270	        'by_owner': by_owner,
   271	        'entries': len(raw_records),
   272	    }

   275	def parse_document(raw_bytes):
   276	    need(len(raw_bytes) <= MAX_INPUT_BYTES)
   277	    try:
   278	        text = raw_bytes.decode('utf-8')
   279	    except UnicodeDecodeError:
   280	        raise Invalid()
   281	    try:
   282	        doc = json.loads(text, parse_float=reject_float,
   283	                         parse_constant=reject_constant,
   284	                         object_pairs_hook=reject_pairs)
   285	    except RecursionError:
   286	        raise Invalid()
   287	    except Invalid:
   288	        raise
   289	    except Exception:
   290	        raise Invalid()
   291	    need(container_depth(doc) <= MAX_DEPTH)
   292	    root = exact_keys(as_dict(doc), ('zones', 'profiles', 'queries',
   293	                                     'observations'))
   294	
   295	    raw_zones = as_list(root['zones'])
   296	    need(len(raw_zones) <= MAX_ZONES)
   297	    zones = []
   298	    origins = set()
   299	    total_entries = 0
   300	    for raw in raw_zones:
   301	        zone = build_zone(as_dict(raw))
   302	        need(zone['origin'] not in origins)
   303	        origins.add(zone['origin'])
   304	        total_entries += zone['entries']
   305	        need(total_entries <= MAX_ZONE_RECORD_ENTRIES)
   306	        zones.append(zone)
   307	    zones.sort(key=lambda z: (-z['labels'], z['origin']))
   308	
   309	    raw_profiles = as_list(root['profiles'])
   310	    need(MIN_PROFILES <= len(raw_profiles) <= MAX_PROFILES)
   311	    profiles = []
   312	    profile_ids = set()
   313	    for raw in raw_profiles:
   314	        obj = exact_keys(as_dict(raw), ('id', 'max_aliases', 'cname',
   315	                                        'wildcard'))
   316	        pid = check_id(obj['id'])
   317	        need(pid not in profile_ids)
   318	        profile_ids.add(pid)
   319	        max_aliases = as_int(obj['max_aliases'])
   320	        need(0 <= max_aliases <= MAX_ALIASES)
   321	        cname = as_str(obj['cname'])
   322	        need(cname in CNAME_MODES)
   323	        wildcard = as_str(obj['wildcard'])
   324	        need(wildcard in WILDCARD_MODES)
   325	        profiles.append({'id': pid, 'max_aliases': max_aliases,
   326	                         'cname': cname, 'wildcard': wildcard})
   327	
   328	    raw_queries = as_list(root['queries'])
   329	    need(len(raw_queries) <= MAX_QUERIES)
   330	    queries = []
